name: Dakara Doushitatte
source:
Main characters are going to Osaka. However, incidents with the dead arising start to occur around them. What will they do in this messed up situation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公一行正准备前往大阪。然而，他们周围开始接连发生死者复生的事件。面对这片混乱的局面，他们会怎么做？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
